goal: Freeze the smallest complete FRONTEND contract for the first-admin /auth/invite callback and fail-closed staff invitation UI under Q's approved invitation-only policy.

source.trustRepair: currently active and owns app.tsx; callback implementation must start only after its clean commit

decisionsToClose: Exact synchronous pre-render fragment capture and history.replaceState seam before React, router, installation fetch or Auth network activity.
Exact closed success/error fragment parser, expiry handling, memory-only handoff into the existing CloudAuth instance, subject conflict check, password update and post-update session disposition.

Exact /auth/invite route and screen states for invite_missing, invite_invalid, invite_expired, invite_session_conflict, password_rejected and provider_unavailable without provider text or credentials.

Whether first-admin success signs out and waits for installer resume before the user's separate first business login. Preserve the approved distinction between Auth acceptance and users.auth_subject binding.

Remove or fail closed every current public staff signUp path and raw CCC-only invitation-link action that contradicts disable_signup=true, while preserving participant public_signup and without inventing the unresolved later-staff Auth issuer marker/TTL/orphan-cleanup contract.
Exact files, symbols, tests and real-browser leak checks. Use existing Wire components and CSS only; no design-lane writes.
requiredBoundaries: Success keys exactly access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, optional expires_at, token_type and type. token_type must be bearer and type invite.
Error keys exactly error, error_code and error_description. Mixed sets, unknown keys, provider tokens, code, sb_flow_id and token_hash are invalid.

Tokens are removed from the visible URL and history before first render or network. Never enter React state/snapshot, router location, browser storage, logs, analytics, referrer, error objects or request URLs.
Use one existing CloudAuth/Supabase client with persistSession false and detectSessionInUrl false. No second client or persistence.

No users row, role, invite consumption or business entry occurs in the callback. The installer resume remains the first-admin binding step; later staff accept still requires the accepted aa0bdb1 server boundary.
No POST /identity/link, public signUp, business-API administrator credential, provider fallback, Auth setting change, actual invite send or deployment.
Keep participant request-link behavior and public_signup capability unchanged.
Operational mailbox, CCC_ONBOARDING_FIRST_ADMIN injection and one live invitation remain separate Q approvals.

mustContain: exact data types, functions, lifecycle and route/screen state machine
exact allowed and excluded paths with app.tsx serialization after trust repair
exact removal or fail-closed treatment of current signUpWithPassword and raw /staff/join link flow
targeted unit and actual-browser acceptance including URL/history/storage/console/network/referrer leak checks
readyForImplementation true only if no semantic decision remains

constraints: Read-only except the result JSON in this orchestrator worktree.
Do not edit product or canonical docs, tickets, branches, commits, remote systems, credentials or live services.
Do not repeat the policy decision. Resolve only the implementation seam and current fail-closed cutover against source.
No new dependency, service, backend endpoint, storage, compatibility alias, UI component or CSS.
